description: Thirty current-season team statistics with concise, beginner-friendly definitions. No live figures appear on Learn.

metrics.label: Wins
metrics.explanation: A win means the team finished a game with more points than its opponent. Only completed regular-season games count.

metrics.label: Losses
metrics.explanation: A loss means the opponent scored more points when the game ended. It counts completed regular-season games.

metrics.label: Win rate
metrics.explanation: A team's share of completed games won. For example, 6 wins in 10 games means a 60% win rate.

metrics.label: Points / game
metrics.explanation: Points are earned by shooting: a free throw gives 1, most baskets give 2, and a long-range three-pointer gives 3.

metrics.label: Opponent points / game
metrics.explanation: How many points the other team scores against this team on average. Fewer points allowed can signal stronger defense.

metrics.label: Score margin / game
metrics.brief: Average points scored minus points allowed.
metrics.explanation: Positive means the team usually outscored opponents; negative means it was usually outscored. This is a description, not a forecast.

metrics.label: Field-goal %
metrics.explanation: Field goals are baskets scored during play, worth 2 or 3 points. Free throws are not included.

metrics.label: 2-point shot %
metrics.explanation: Measures success on shots taken inside the three-point line, excluding free throws.

metrics.label: 3-point shot %
metrics.explanation: A three-pointer is a successful shot from behind the three-point line. This shows how often those attempts go in.

metrics.label: Free-throw %
metrics.explanation: Free throws are uncontested 1-point attempts awarded after certain fouls. This is how often the team makes them.

metrics.label: Effective FG %
metrics.explanation: Like field-goal percentage, but gives extra weight to made three-pointers because they score 3 points instead of 2.

metrics.label: 3-point attempt rate
metrics.brief: Share of shots attempted from three.
metrics.explanation: Shows the team's reliance on long-range shooting: three-point attempts divided by all field-goal attempts.

metrics.label: Free-throw attempt rate
metrics.brief: Free throws attempted per field-goal attempt.
metrics.explanation: Shows how often a team gets free-throw attempts relative to its normal shots. A higher value isn't automatically better.

metrics.label: Field goals made / game
metrics.explanation: Counts successful shots during play (not free throws), averaged over all games.

metrics.label: Field-goal tries / game
metrics.explanation: Counts every attempted 2- or 3-point shot, successful or not, averaged across games.

metrics.label: 3-pointers made / game
metrics.explanation: Shows how many long-range shots go in each game, on average.

metrics.label: 3-point tries / game
metrics.explanation: Shows how many three-point shots a team takes in an average game.

metrics.label: Free throws made / game
metrics.explanation: Shows how many points a team earns from successful free throws each game, on average.

metrics.label: Free-throw tries / game
metrics.explanation: Shows how often a team attempts uncontested 1-point free throws per game.

metrics.label: Rebounds / game
metrics.explanation: After a missed shot, a rebound is gaining control of the ball. A team can rebound on offense or defense.

metrics.label: Offensive rebounds / game
metrics.explanation: When the shooting team recovers its own miss, it gets another chance to score.

metrics.label: Defensive rebounds / game
metrics.explanation: When the defending team collects an opponent's miss, it usually gains possession.

metrics.label: Assists / game
metrics.brief: Average passes leading directly to baskets.
metrics.explanation: An assist is credited when a pass directly helps a teammate make a field goal.

metrics.label: Turnovers / game
metrics.explanation: A turnover gives the ball to the opponent before the team can finish its possession with a shot.

metrics.label: Assists / turnover
metrics.explanation: Compares baskets created by passes with possessions lost. It describes ball movement and care, not just shooting.

metrics.label: Steals / game
metrics.explanation: A steal happens when a defender legally takes the ball from an opposing team.

metrics.label: Blocks / game
metrics.explanation: A blocked shot is when a defender legally touches a shot attempt and stops or changes its path.

metrics.label: Fouls / game
metrics.explanation: A personal foul is illegal physical contact. Too many can give the opponent free throws and limit players' minutes.

metrics.label: 2-pointers made / game
metrics.explanation: Counts successful field goals worth two points, excluding three-pointers and free throws.

metrics.label: 2-point tries / game
metrics.explanation: Counts all attempts from inside the three-point line, averaged over games.
